<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="decision-patterns">
<h1>Decision patterns</h1>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pyjev</span></code> supports common decision patterns by combining typed Jev judgments with
ordinary Python policy. Jev evaluates ambiguous questions. The application then
uses the structured results to route work, combine signals, gate automation, or
ignore answers that are not relevant to the selected branch.</p>
<p>The boundary is intentional:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>TypeSafe and Jev provide model evaluation, typed question semantics, result
probabilities, confidence, and request metadata.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pyjev</span></code> provides reusable decision declarations, bundles, typed result
wrappers, offline inspection, and access to preserved uncertainty.</p></li>
<li><p>Application code owns deterministic facts, thresholds, normalization, weights,
handlers, side effects, and business policy.</p></li>
</ul>
<section id="intent-routing">
<h2>Intent routing</h2>
<p>Use a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Choice</span></code> question for the intent and route from its selected value. Add
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Score</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Noul</span></code> questions when a branch needs extra signals.</p>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">[decision.ticket-router]</span>
<span class="n">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;bundle&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[decision.ticket-router.questions.intent]</span>
<span class="n">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;choice&quot;</span>
<span class="n">question</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;What is the primary intent of this customer message?&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[decision.ticket-router.questions.intent.options]</span>
<span class="n">order_status</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Asking about an existing order&quot;</span>
<span class="n">product_question</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Asking about a product before buying&quot;</span>
<span class="n">return_exchange</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Wants to return or exchange something&quot;</span>
<span class="n">complaint</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Unhappy with the experience and wants resolution&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[decision.ticket-router.questions.complexity]</span>
<span class="n">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;score&quot;</span>
<span class="n">question</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;How complex is this request to resolve?&quot;</span>
<span class="n">levels</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="s2">&quot;Simple lookup or standard procedure&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="s2">&quot;Requires judgment or a multi-step process&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="s2">&quot;Unusual situation, edge case, or escalation needed&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The bundle is evaluated once, and Python chooses the handler:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">BundleResult</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ChoiceResult</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ScoreResult</span>

<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">decide</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;ticket-router&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">state</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;message&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">message</span><span class="p">})</span>

<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="nb">isinstance</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">BundleResult</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">intent</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">answers</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">&quot;intent&quot;</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="n">complexity</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">answers</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">&quot;complexity&quot;</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="nb">isinstance</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">intent</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ChoiceResult</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="nb">isinstance</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">complexity</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ScoreResult</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">intent</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">confidence</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mf">0.50</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">route_to_human</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">intent</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;order_status&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">handle_order_status</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">intent</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;complaint&quot;</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">complexity</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">route_to_human</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">handle_intent</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">intent</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pyjev</span></code> does not provide a handler registry or a generic router. Invoking a
handler is application behavior, so the application keeps ownership of side
effects, retries, and idempotency.</p>
</section>
<section id="composite-scoring">
<h2>Composite scoring</h2>
<p>A bundle can ask for several independent <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Score</span></code> dimensions in one request.
Normalize and combine those dimensions in Python:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">weights</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;python_depth&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mf">0.40</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;leadership&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mf">0.10</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;system_design&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mf">0.40</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;generalist&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mf">0.10</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="n">composite</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">weights</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">name</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">answers</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">name</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">answers</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">name</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">legend</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">name</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">weights</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ScoreResult.value</span></code> is the probability-weighted position over the ordered
levels, so fractional values are expected. Keep normalization and weights in
application code. They are deterministic policy and do not change the Jev
request or belong in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.pyjev.toml</span></code> unless the project deliberately adopts a
broader application-policy DSL.</p>
<p>This keeps the model contract and the business ranking contract separate. The
application can change weights, compare candidates, or define different
policies without changing the atomic Jev questions.</p>
</section>
<section id="confidence-gated-routing">
<h2>Confidence-gated routing</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ChoiceResult.confidence</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ScoreResult.confidence</span></code> are preserved separately
from the selected value and probability distribution. Use the signal for the
specific action being considered, with thresholds appropriate to that action:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">decide</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;banking-intent&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">state</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">command</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">confidence</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mf">0.60</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">route_to_support</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;check_balance&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">show_balance</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;approve_transfer&quot;</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">confidence</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mf">0.85</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">approve_transfer</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">ask_user_to_confirm</span><span class="p">()</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Confidence is not a correctness probability. It is a model signal that the
caller may use as part of an explicit policy. The CLI exposes
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--min-confidence</span></code> for direct Choice and Score decisions and named primitive
decisions. Python policy is the right place for different thresholds per
consequence.</p>
<section id="result-pipeline-form">
<h3>Result-pipeline form</h3>
<p>The same child-specific gate can be expressed with the optional local pipeline API:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev.pipeline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">answer</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">require_confidence</span>

<span class="n">route_policy</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">answer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;intent&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="n">require_confidence</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">0.60</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">outcome</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="n">route_policy</span>

<span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">outcome</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">passed</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">handle_intent</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">outcome</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">route_to_human</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">outcome</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>This is an ergonomic alternative to the explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">if</span></code> form above. It does not make a network request, dispatch a handler, or add aggregate confidence to a bundle. For a Noul child, use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">require_probability(at_least=...)</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">require_probability(at_most=...)</span></code> instead of a confidence gate.
Bundles deliberately have no aggregate confidence. A bundle may contain a
high-confidence intent, a low-confidence severity, and another signal with a
different consequence. Gate the child result that controls the action instead
of inventing one bundle threshold. A <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">NoulResult</span></code> also has no Choice or Score
confidence field; use its explicit probability value when that is the relevant
policy signal.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="speculative-fan-out">
<h2>Speculative fan-out</h2>
<p>A named bundle is the first-class speculative fan-out primitive. Put every
potentially useful question in one bundle, send one request for the shared
state, and consume only the answers relevant to the selected route.</p>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">[decision.ticket-triage]</span>
<span class="n">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;bundle&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[decision.ticket-triage.questions.category]</span>
<span class="n">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;choice&quot;</span>
<span class="n">question</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;What is the category of this ticket?&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[decision.ticket-triage.questions.category.options]</span>
<span class="n">bug</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Technical problem&quot;</span>
<span class="n">billing</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Payment or refund problem&quot;</span>
<span class="n">other</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Another support request&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[decision.ticket-triage.questions.refund-requested]</span>
<span class="n">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;noul&quot;</span>
<span class="n">question</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;The customer explicitly asks for a refund or credit.&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[decision.ticket-triage.questions.bug-severity]</span>
<span class="n">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;score&quot;</span>
<span class="n">question</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;How severe is the technical issue?&quot;</span>
<span class="n">levels</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">&quot;Minor&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Degraded&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Blocking&quot;</span><span class="p">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The application can inspect <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">category</span></code>, then use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">bug-severity</span></code> only for a bug
route and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">refund-requested</span></code> only for a billing route. Unused answers remain
available in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BundleResult</span></code> for diagnostics, but they do not affect a branch
unless application code chooses to use them.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Jev.run()</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AsyncJev.run()</span></code> remain lower-level dynamic fan-out escape
hatches and return the SDK-shaped response dictionary. Use a named bundle when
the question set is reusable and you want <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BundleResult</span></code> with typed child
wrappers. Do not silently change the dynamic <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">run()</span></code> return contract.</p>
</section>
<section id="all-four-patterns-together">
<h2>All four patterns together</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">examples/support_triage.py</span></code> combines the patterns in one support workflow. Its
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">support-triage</span></code> bundle asks for intent, complexity, severity, reproducibility,
refund likelihood, and frustration before the route is known. The example then:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p>gates low-confidence intent classifications to a human;</p></li>
<li><p>sends order-status requests to a deterministic lookup;</p></li>
<li><p>uses severity confidence, severity score, and reproducibility for bug
escalation;</p></li>
<li><p>uses refund probability for billing policy;</p></li>
<li><p>uses frustration as a cross-cutting priority flag;</p></li>
<li><p>ignores speculative answers that do not control the selected route.</p></li>
</ol>
<p>The example prints the request and result metadata so the one-request fan-out
and the separation between judgment and policy are visible.</p>
</section>
<section id="design-boundaries">
<h2>Design boundaries</h2>
<p>Do not add a generic <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">jev.route()</span></code> handler framework, aggregate
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">bundle.confidence</span></code>, or composite weights to the named-decision schema merely to
express these patterns. The reusable library contract is typed judgment plus
preserved uncertainty. Routing, ranking, thresholds, normalization, and side
effects are deterministic application policy and should remain explicit in
Python.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
